description: This file defines a partial class 'SetExam1' which inherits from 'System.Web.UI.Page'. It contains event handlers for various button clicks that navigate to different pages within the online examination system, such as admin panel, leaderboard, theory set, MCQ set, and login page.

classes.name: SetExam1
classes.description: A code-behind class for the ASP.NET webpage that handles button click events to navigate between different parts of the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for home button, transfers to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for profile button; currently does nothing.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for leaderboard button, transfers to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: theoryB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for theory button, transfers to TheorySet.aspx.

methods.name: mcqB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for MCQ button, transfers to MCQSet.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for logout button, transfers to LoginPage.aspx.
